Re: Appeal of Medical-Necessity Denial  
Member: Skyler Alvarez  
Member ID: W468430798  
Reference number: POC-A0D25E0D66-82168  
Requested service: Lumbar decompression/disc surgery  
CPT: 63030  
Date of denial notice: August 5, 2026  

Dear Peach State Health Plan Appeals Department:

I am appealing the denial of authorization for my requested lower-back disc surgery/decompression, CPT 63030. The stated reason for denial was that the submitted records did not document an adequate trial of conservative treatment.

The clinical records do document extensive conservative treatment:

- I completed 14 weeks of supervised physical therapy, including core stabilization and lumbar flexibility, from April 4, 2026, through July 11, 2026. I completed 18 visits, as documented in the physical therapy discharge note.
- I used NSAIDs for approximately eight months, with inadequate relief.
- I received a corticosteroid injection on April 29, 2026. It provided only three weeks of partial relief.
- My symptoms have continued for approximately 12 months and include progressive lower-back pain that is not relieved by rest, radicular pain extending into the right calf, and substantial functional limitation. I cannot stand for more than 10 minutes.

The publicly available Peach State Health Plan clinical-policy page lists the policy titled Disc Decompression Procedures, policy number CP.MP.114. The retrieved policy states that open discectomy and microdiscectomy may be medically necessary when the applicable clinical requirements are met. For conservative treatment, the policy requires, among other things, at least four weeks of physical therapy or a prescribed home exercise program, at least four weeks of activity modification, and either at least three weeks of an NSAID or acetaminophen unless contraindicated or not tolerated, or an epidural steroid injection.

My records satisfy and substantially exceed the documented conservative-treatment requirements:

- Physical therapy: 14 weeks and 18 completed visits, rather than four weeks.
- Medication: NSAID treatment for eight months, rather than three weeks.
- Injection: corticosteroid injection with documented partial and temporary relief.
- Persistent symptoms: approximately 12 months of progressive pain despite these measures.

The records also document objective structural and clinical findings supporting the requested procedure. A July 6, 2026, MRI showed an L4-L5 disc extrusion with severe right lateral recess stenosis and compression of the traversing L5 nerve root. Examination documented positive provocative testing on the affected side and a neurologic deficit corresponding to the imaged level. My right-calf radicular pain and inability to stand for more than 10 minutes demonstrate that the condition is causing significant functional impairment.

The records further document that there is no active infection, no untreated substance-use condition, BMI 29, and no smoking history. These facts do not identify a clinical barrier to the requested surgery. The procedure was requested by Marchetti, MD, orthopedic surgery, based on the documented symptoms, examination findings, MRI results, and failure of conservative care.

I respectfully request that Peach State Health Plan:

1. Reverse the denial and approve the requested lumbar decompression/disc surgery, CPT 63030;
2. Have the request reviewed by a qualified orthopedic or spine specialist who was not involved in the initial denial;
3. Consider the complete physical therapy discharge note, medication history, injection response, MRI report, examination findings, and functional limitations; and
4. If the denial is maintained, provide the specific criteria applied to CPT 63030, the policy version used, the clinical reviewer’s rationale, and identification of any InterQual or delegated-vendor criteria relied upon.

Please treat this letter as a timely member appeal. The appeal form states that an appeal must be filed within 180 calendar days of the denial letter. Please acknowledge receipt and provide the appeal determination in writing.

Sincerely,

Skyler Alvarez  
Member ID: W468430798  
[Mailing address]

Enclosures: Physical therapy discharge note; medication-treatment history; corticosteroid injection record; July 6, 2026 MRI report; orthopedic examination and clinical notes; prior authorization denial notice.
